profile.description: Voltamp Energy SAOG, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, distributes, and sells transformers, medium and low voltage switchgears, and panels in the Sultanate of Oman. It offers power transformers; corrugated type, special duty, hermetically sealed type, solar inverter duty, and earthing transformers; motor duty, booster, isolation, and furnace transformers; solar power, green energy, and wind transformers, as well as solar skid solutions; and dry type distribution transformers. The company also provides package sub-station solutions; reactors; and MV and LV switchgears. In addition, it offers repair, overhauling, and maintenance services of transformers and switchgears for utilities, oil and gas companies, power plants, structures and buildings, industrial and government sectors, etc. The company offers its products for various applications, including power generation and distribution, power transmission, infrastructure, renewable, offshore, and railway. It also exports its products. Voltamp Energy SAOG was founded in 1987 and is based in Rusayl, the Sultanate of Oman.
